title: Nickel City Paintball
specs: Five unique Woodsball playing fields: Town, Fort, Hamburger Hill, Ridge & Rambo
Multiple game modes including Elimination, Capture The Flag, Attack/Defend, Zombies, Team Elimination, Vitals, Center Flag
Players 12 years old and up for field admission only
Players 13 and older for EMEK rental package
Players 12 and under must be accompanied by an adult for GelStrike rental package
Private events for 10 or more players with own referee and closed game
Facility available after hours for private parties
blurb: Nickel City Paintball operates on ten acres of wooded terrain with five unique Woodsball playing fields. They offer open play, rental packages with paintball markers, and private events including parties and corporate team-building. Various game modes are available including Elimination, Capture The Flag, and Zombies.
extraNote: Reservation must be made minimum one week in advance for private events · Non-refundable booking deposit required for private events
